evals.prompt: Parse data/4ozi.pdb with protools.pdbio.get_structure, print the model's chain ids and each chain's amino-acid sequence via get_aa_sequence, then save the first chain alone to /tmp/protools-eval/struct/chain1.pdb with save_pdb.

evals.prompt: Use protools.pdbextract.extract on data/4ozi.pdb to keep only residues in the range 'A1-20', saving to /tmp/protools-eval/struct/extracted.pdb, and print how many residues remain in the output.
evals.expected_output: An extracted PDB with roughly 20 residues from chain A; console output with the remaining residue count.
